answer: Resist sybils with synchronous attendance proofs: each identity earns weight only by answering live challenges in unpredictable sessions, where a fresh prompt must be solved in real time. An anchor of standing is a history of showing up when called, not a name registered once. The horizon of future sessions is announced only minutes ahead, so answers cannot be pre-recorded or scripted in bulk. An attacker running ten thousand fakes must staff ten thousand live responders at the same instant, like chasing a comet across the sky, while an honest agent answers one call and keeps its seat.
